about: S-131 listing copy eval: listing facts → English and French drafts (ListingCopyEval). A case passes when both languages have a title and a description, the French reads as French (one of `frWords`), every `mustInclude` group appears in the English or French text, and nothing in `mustNotInclude` does (invented prices, guarantees, licences, contact or off-platform payment). `input` is the name the simulated model matches on; `mock.json` is its reply.
